## WhatsApp Booking Bridge
WhatsApp Cloud API webhook (GET verification + POST messages). Parses the incoming message, runs the same booking conversation as the AI Booking Assistant, replies on WhatsApp and sends a Telegram card when a booking is complete.
**Plug in:** WhatsApp Cloud API token + verify token, OpenAI, YOUR_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID.
**Test:** point the Meta webhook to /webhook/whatsapp-booking and send a WhatsApp message.
